integrity_guardrails.purpose: CRITICAL. Six uploaded documents tell materially DIFFERENT stories about Fernando's education, current job, and certification path. Building applications on the inflated/contradictory versions risks credential fraud, federal false-statement exposure (USAJOBS/NIST), academic-integrity failure (Moffitt PhD), and trivial fact-check failure. Everything must be reconciled to PRIMARY SOURCES (WES report, diplomas, TGH HR record, AAB/AMT records) before submission.
do_not_claim: Any inflated TGH title ('Lead Biospecimen Data Specialist,' 'Research Laboratory Manager,' 'Translational cancer researcher') — his supervisor's own letter calls him 'Phlebotomist and Laboratory Support Specialist.'
'Computational biologist / biomedical data scientist,' machine-learning, or data-pipeline expertise.

Daily operation of flow cytometry / cryopreservation engineering / ownership of LIS (Meditech/SoftLab/LabWare/REDCap/Medidata Rave) — NOT supported by the supervisor letter, which describes specimen collection + basic sample-tracking tools.
'Clinical Research Data Consultant (Independent)' role — not verified; omit unless real with references.
'ASCP Board of Certification candidate' / 'ASCP MLS/MT Examination Candidate' — inconsistent with AAB and AMT claims elsewhere; he is not ASCP-certified.

Fabricated precision metrics ('12+ SOPs authored at TGH,' '30% error reduction,' '100% QC pass rate,' '100+ specimens/week owned,' 'zero deficiencies') — these describe director-level work and are not attributable to his phlebotomy role.
'Two Master's degrees' or a full 'M.S. Oncology Cytology' UNTIL the WES report confirms it (other documents call cytology a specialization/graduate certificate).

role_positioning_strategy.clinical_research: Lead with lab-director SOP/QA rigor + real IRB research + specimen handling + documentation discipline + bilingual patient interaction. Frame phlebotomy as direct study-visit and specimen-collection experience. Add CITI/GCP to strengthen instantly. Do not wait for AAB to apply — this path does not need state technologist licensure.
role_positioning_strategy.lab_operations: Lead with 11 years directing a multi-department diagnostic lab + current U.S. hospital lead role. Emphasize staffing, QC, SOP authorship, compliance, workflow, and training. Strongest overlap with U.S. titles.
role_positioning_strategy.pathology_cytology_assistant: Lead with cytology specialization + biopathology master's + histology thesis + specimen handling. Academically over-qualified for assistant roles = high interview probability and fast onboarding.
role_positioning_strategy.specimen_processing: Lead with accessioning/specimen-integrity language and current hospital throughput. Supervisor angle uses his director history.
role_positioning_strategy.phlebotomy_lead: Direct match. Lead with current title, hospital setting, training, and bilingual patient care. Highest probability of interview and offer.
role_positioning_strategy.medical_courier: Fast income lane. Lead with hospital familiarity, specimen handling, HIPAA/OSHA, cold-chain and chain-of-custody discipline. Only accept routes netting >= $22/hr after gas/vehicle costs.
role_positioning_strategy.qa_qc: Lead with lab QC/compliance, SOP authorship, documentation, and audit-readiness from director years.
role_positioning_strategy.teaching_training: Lead with 11-yr professor + program-lead role + current staff training. Ideal for biomedical tutoring, phlebotomy instructor, or Portuguese medical/science tutoring. Lead with biomedical science, not just phlebotomy.
role_positioning_strategy.interpreting: Portuguese medical interpreting leverages native fluency + biomedical vocabulary; low certification barrier (40-hr course).
role_positioning_strategy.data_coordinator: Lead with documentation discipline, lab terminology fluency, and detail orientation; remote-friendly and low certification barrier.
role_positioning_strategy.federal_usajobs: For NIST/VA/federal lab-adjacent roles, apply through USAJOBS WITH spouse veterans' preference. Position honestly on real strengths (WES M.Sc., cytology, 11-yr lab director, real research, phlebotomy). Do NOT overstate TGH duties or claim ASCP candidacy.
